title: International Licensing, Franchising & Strategic Alliances
shelf_blurb: All fourteen sessions of International Licensing, Franchising & Strategic Alliances, from the four market entry strategies through licensing and franchising to their contracts and laws, with the Disney, ARM, Apple vs. Qualcomm and Burgerim cases, 160 flashcards plus 25 abbreviations, an 80-question quiz and a mock exam.
